knownCompatibilityDecisions.expected: A different owned task may consider an earlier review of the same bill for a warning, without equating the review with payment or modifying hasPriorPayment.
knownCompatibilityDecisions.resolution: Generic release behavior is modeled. Whether to extend the configured bill helper remains a separate compatibility decision.

knownCompatibilityDecisions.observed: A Spanish Pagar page returned a human-review pointer where the money person-check was expected.
knownCompatibilityDecisions.expected: The person-check and payment-step record precede the payment pointer when the localized control is consequential.
knownCompatibilityDecisions.resolution: The guidance decision models the obligations once money-changing control evidence is established. Localized extraction/classification must be checked in the replacement host.
